description: Lists the calendars on the connected account's calendar list: its own, shared ones it has added, and subscribed ones such as holidays. Returns one compact entry per calendar: its ID, title, whether it is the primary calendar, the account's access role (owner, writer, reader or freeBusyReader) and its time zone, plus a page token when more remain. The ID is what calendar_list_events and the other calendar tools take as calendar_id.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

max_results.description: The most calendars to return in one page (default: 50, at most 250).

page_token.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier call, to read the page after it.

name: gws-mcp__calendar_list_calendars
